correctness.rationale: For the admissible constant function f(m)=1, the recurrence becomes star_f(n)=1-n-sum_{d=2}^{n-1}star_f(d). The base case n=2 is -1, and if all earlier values are -1 then the sum is -(n-2), so star_f(n)=-1. Thus every n>=2, including composite n=4, has value -1. A fresh bounded replay through n=100 independently matched the induction; the infinite conclusion rests on the induction, not the finite check.
residual_risks: The claim is scoped to the literal fixed-function theorem under the stated admissibility condition f(1)=1; it does not refute a differently quantified universal-over-f reformulation.
